title: A 17-Foot Crocodile Bit With 3,700 Pounds of Force

scenes.text: This animal's bite is the strongest ever measured.
In 2012, scientists tested a 17-foot saltwater crocodile.
That beat the old record, 2,980 pounds, from an American alligator.
The pressure on a single tooth hit 350,000 pounds per square inch.
3,700 pounds. And that was one bite.

description:
A 17-foot saltwater crocodile bit with 3,700 pounds of force, the strongest bite ever recorded in a study.
One tooth reached a pressure of 350,000 pounds per square inch.
Could anything survive that?
first_comment: 3,700 pounds of bite force. Which animal would you least want to meet?
